objective: Normalize the small Telnyx Voice webhook event subset needed by the operator-first bridge without introducing webhook transport, signature verification, persistence, or runtime side effects.
rules: Provider webhook id becomes providerEventId evidence only.
call_control_id remains provider reference evidence and never becomes River identity.
Unknown Telnyx event types return undefined and cannot silently advance canonical state.
Recognized event types require a valid event id, ISO-compatible occurred_at timestamp, record_type event, and call_control_id.
Normalized events retain only explicitly modeled lifecycle evidence and never retain the raw provider payload.
Normalization performs no persistence and no network operation.
next: INS-002E2B3 composes authenticated normalized events with provider-reference lookup and durable provider-event receipt deduplication.
